title: BBC Chillers
paragraphs: A small BBC Radio 4 collection of full-cast horror and science-fiction dramatizations, built around unsettling stories and literary adaptations rather than a continuing cast or storyline.
Four-part BBC Radio 4 science-fiction/horror anthology adapted by Mike Walker from published stories. Frozen GRH set contains the complete four-program run in broadcast order.
GRH documents the program through BBC Radio 4 Chillers (January 24, 2002 to February 14, 2002) on [[org|org.deepv2.507b7f3aadcb7123|BBC Radio 4]].

Among the most extensively documented contributors in the GRH holdings are Mike Walker (radio adaptor on 4 recordings), Ned Chaillet (director on 2 recordings), Rachel Horan (director on 2 recordings), Abi Eniola (performer on 1 recording), Ben Onwukwe (performer on 1 recording), Bill Bailey (performer on 1 recording), and Christopher Godwin (performer on 1 recording).

Its indexed subjects and listening characteristics include science fiction and speculative horror, literary radio adaptation, isolation and confinement, artificial intelligence and machine domination, Vietnam War and combat trauma, and telepathy and psychic connection.
GRH also places the series in documented historical contexts including BBC Radio 4 Chillers four-part run and Modern BBC adaptation of classic and contemporary speculative fiction.
